newsitem.title: UK: UK MEALS AND FEEDS STEADY, TRADE PICKS UP.
newsitem.headline: UK MEALS AND FEEDS STEADY, TRADE PICKS UP.

text.p: UK meals and feeds prices were steady on Thursday with some brokers reporting signs of a pickup in business.
"It's nothing fantastic but the mid-protein market (rapemeal, corn gluten and palmkernel pellets) has been showing signs of life," said one broker.
"Business has been going on and the last ten days have been quite good, but people are reluctant to report the trade," said another.
Brokers said at 87 stg a tonne for nearby rapemeal is a good buy against soymeal at 197 stg.
Soymeal is trading hand-to-mouth and maybe a month ahead while mid-proteins are trading further forward.
"A lot of people have been sitting on their hands hoping prices would come down, but now sterling has started to fall they are getting worried," said another broker.
Brokers said normally the "top up" trade would keep their market going, but the BSE scare had gone deeper than many expected.
"There has been about a 20 percent drop in business since the BSE scare so there has not been the need for compounds to top-up from the middle market," said one.
High protein soymeal was offered around one stg to three stg up while rapemeal saw offers two to three stg higher.
